get.description: Returns the eligibility recalls of the account, with their address or building reference, the requested fiber offers and whether each one is completed.

post.description: Creates a recall on an address or building reference, to check again its eligibility to Pro Fiber FTTH or Dedicated Fiber FTTO/FTTE. Returns the created recall.

delete.description: Deletes the eligibility recall of an address or building reference.

get.description: Returns an eligibility recall: its address or building reference, the fiber offers it checks (Pro Fiber FTTH, Dedicated Fiber FTTO/FTTE), and its creation, update and completion dates.

put.description: Updates the reference and the fiber offers to check of an eligibility recall. Returns the updated recall.

post.summary: Search the addresses near a location
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the addresses around a GPS location with their coordinates, street code, building reference and distance. The search radius is 10 meters by default.

post.summary: Get the details of a building
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the name, type, NRO and stairs of a building given by its identifier. Get the identifier with the search/buildings calls.

post.summary: Search the buildings of an address
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the buildings at an address with their reference, name, type, NRO and stairs. The address needs at least a street code and street number, or a Hexacle.

post.summary: Search the buildings of a line number
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the buildings linked to a line number and its status, with their reference, name, type, NRO and stairs.

post.summary: Search the localities of a zip code
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the cities and localities linked to a zip code with their INSEE code. Use the INSEE code to search the streets of a locality.

post.summary: Search the lines at an address
post.description: **Deprecated**: this endpoint is scheduled for deletion. Returns, as an asynchronous task, the inactive copper lines at an address, and the active ones when the owner name is given (at least its first three characters).
Returns, as an asynchronous task, the available time slots for a copper line creation or a fiber installation meeting, for an eligibility test reference and a chosen offer.

post.summary: Search the numbers of a street
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the available street numbers of a street given by its street code. Get the street code with search/streets.

post.summary: Search the numbers of a street with their details
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the available street numbers of a street given by its street code, each with its Hexacle address identifier. Get the street code with search/streets.

post.summary: Search the streets of a locality
post.description: Returns, as an asynchronous task, the streets of a locality given by its INSEE code, with their name, street code and alternative code. Get the INSEE code with search/cities.

get.description: Returns the result of an eligibility test from its reference: the tested endpoint (address, copper or fiber details, portability) and the offers with their eligibility, estimated rates and reasons when not eligible.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of an address
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on an address, given by its street code and street number or by its Hexacle. Get them with the search/streets and search/streetNumbers/details calls. Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of an address for a partner
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on an address, given by its street code and street number or by its Hexacle. Reserved for partners. Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of a building
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on a building, for fiber only. Get the building identifier with the search/buildings calls. Set productFamily to scope the test (ISP by default). Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of a building for a partner
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on a building, for fiber only. Reserved for partners. Get the building identifier with the search/buildings calls. Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of a copper line
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on a line number, for copper only. Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of a copper line for a partner
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on a line number, for copper only. Reserved for partners. Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of an OTP
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on an Optical Termination Panel (OTP) identifier, for fiber only. Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

post.summary: Test the eligibility of an OTP for a partner
post.description: Starts an eligibility test on an Optical Termination Panel (OTP) identifier, for fiber only. Reserved for partners. Returns an asynchronous task, pending until its result holds the eligibility reference, the endpoint and the eligible offers.

get.summary: List the work planned by operators for a partner
get.description: Returns the planned work operations of network operators, with their dates, duration, impact, impacted NRA/NRO and departments. Reserved for partners.

get.summary: List the work planned by operators
get.description: Returns the planned work operations of network operators, with their dates, duration, impact, impacted NRA/NRO and departments. Filter on the begin and end dates.

parameters.name: beginDate
parameters.description: List only work planned started after this date

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: List only work planned ending prior to this date

get.summary: List the generic incidents for a partner
get.description: Returns the detected, validated and recently closed generic incidents, with their impacted operators, technologies, NRA/NRO and departments, and their estimated resolution date. Reserved for partners.

parameters.name: creationDate
parameters.description: List only incidents created after this date

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: List only incidents closed prior to this date

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by the status of the incident (detected, validated or closed)

get.description: Returns the validated and recently closed generic incidents, with their impacted operators, technologies, NRA/NRO and departments, and their estimated resolution date. Filter on the dates and the status.

parameters.name: creationDate
parameters.description: List only incidents created after this date

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: List only incidents closed prior to this date

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by the status of the incident (validated or closed)
